text.description_html:
Omnia 3911P-US32D, Square Passage Sliding Pocket Door Set

A complete set, the Square Stainless Steel Passage Pocket Door Set comes with 2 square sliding pocket door cup pulls and a matching fingertip edge pull. It is made out of stainless steel with a brushed stainless steel finish. The Square Passage Sliding Pocket Door Set allows for free egress.

The finger edge pull is pressure mounted into the door's edge so that you have something to grip in order to slide the door out of the pocket. The square flush pulls are pressure mounted into the door's face. No screws are needed for a clean contemporary appearance.

Pocket Door Passage Function: This set neither locks nor latches. It features two flush pulls and a finger edge pull to help retrieve the door from the pocket.

Also Available: Square Privacy Pocket Door Lock and Square Double Pocket Door Set

Specifications of the Omnia 3911P Square Pocket Door Set:

  • Material: .050" Thick Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Overall Length: 2-3/16" square
  • Edge Pull Diameter: 1-3/16"
  • Edge Pull Depth: 1-19/32"
  • Mounting Hole Length: 1-7/8" square
  • Overall Depth: 7/8"
  • Mounting Hole Depth: 1/4"
  • Projection: 1/16"

Sold as a Set: two (2) square flush pulls and a square edge pull. For One (1) Door.
